invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should not be null at exit.
The method is called with preppedRecords as part of its core operation; a null input would likely have been handled earlier.
A valid instantTime is required for all table operations and is passed through to the commit action.
A non-null engine context is necessary for processing records and delegating execution.
result is of type HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so getWriteStatuses() should return a List.
